issues.description: The added folder-filter branch builds the query as `{ folderId: String(folder) }` with NO `ownerId: userId` constraint, so any authenticated user can list another user's documents by passing `?folder=<id>`. Only the else branch (no folder) keeps the ownership scope. This is an IDOR / broken access control introduced while adding filtering — the owner constraint must be part of every branch (e.g. `{ ownerId: userId, folderId: ... }`).
